name: Nested loop join
description: Sum order amounts per customer by scanning every order for every customer.
fixture_description: customers: n_customers dicts with unique ids; orders: n_orders dicts with a customer_id (about orphan_ratio unknown ids) and a 2-decimal float amount.

expected_output.description: (name, total) per customer in customer order; totals compared with math.isclose.

suspected_bottleneck: Inner loop over all orders for every customer: O(customers * orders).
